name: workflow-pilot
description: Локальный проект и ChatGPT в одном окне

scripts.prestart: npm run stage:workflow-kit && npm run stage:page-observer && npm run stage:chatgpt-plugin
scripts.pretest: npm run stage:workflow-kit && npm run stage:page-observer && npm run stage:chatgpt-plugin
scripts.presmoke: npm run stage:workflow-kit && npm run stage:page-observer && npm run stage:chatgpt-plugin
scripts.prebuild: npm run stage:workflow-kit && npm run stage:page-observer && npm run stage:chatgpt-plugin && npm run stage:vendor-notices
scripts.prebuild:mac: npm run stage:workflow-kit && npm run stage:page-observer && npm run stage:chatgpt-plugin && npm run stage:vendor-notices
scripts.build:mac: npm run check:mac-signing && npm run prepare:mac && npm run build:mac:package && npm run sign:mac
scripts.prebuild:linux: npm run stage:workflow-kit && npm run stage:page-observer && npm run stage:chatgpt-plugin && npm run stage:vendor-notices
scripts.build:linux: npm run prepare:linux && npm run build:linux:package && npm run verify:linux
scripts.prebuild:win: npm run stage:workflow-kit && npm run stage:page-observer && npm run stage:chatgpt-plugin && npm run stage:vendor-notices
scripts.build:win: npm run prepare:win && npm run build:win:package && npm run verify:win
scripts.check:architecture: depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type err-long src packages/workflow-kit/src resources scripts
